proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you provide a small, shareable Parquet sample (or minimal generated files) that still triggers this error when read with your query, together with the complete Python traceback and the exact `read_parquet` call you used? The sample should reproduce the ConversionException so we can identify which column and which file cause the cast failure.
proposal.rationale: The report describes a cast failure but the underlying input files are private; without a reproducible Parquet sample or generated equivalent and the full traceback, maintainers cannot determine which column or file triggers the ConversionException and cannot reproduce the issue.
